property_summary: For every inputs (identifier, time, ancillaryData) C.getPrice(...) does not revert and returns the default zero int256 (i.e., it does not depend on the time parameter); the mutant violates this by returning int256(uint256(time)) which for some fuzzed time values yields a non-zero result differing from the reference.
change_summary: Return the uint256-converted time parameter as int256, changing output to depend on input time.
